changeSet.author: atlas-corretoras
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE corretora DROP CONSTRAINT ck_corretora_regulatory_status
ALTER TABLE corretora ADD CONSTRAINT ck_corretora_regulatory_status CHECK (regulatory_status IN ('NOT_CHECKED','VERIFIED','NOT_FOUND','INACTIVE','INCOMPATIBLE','STALE','UNAVAILABLE'))

rollback.sql: UPDATE corretora SET regulatory_status = 'NOT_FOUND' WHERE regulatory_status IN ('INACTIVE','INCOMPATIBLE')
